text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes in urine, and presence of bacteria. Mild hematuria is present. Low urine specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
